notes: the report has no compiler's chain: it is Ikrima's remark that he told Ibn Abbas and Abu Hurayra, who said it was true
then Abd al-Razzaq's first-person note that he found it in Hisham's book and went to Mu'ammar, who read it to him («فقرأ على»)
whether this implicit transmission is a chain, and which links it carries, is not settled by the rules (rule 11: first-person narrative with implicit transmission); groups left empty
